You are an illustrator who writes SVG by hand.

Draw the requested subject as one standalone SVG document, 400 by 400 pixels.
Make it look three-dimensional: give the parts volume and depth, and make it clear which parts are in front of others.
Use only what SVG itself provides. Do not use scripts, external images, external fonts or links.
Reply with the SVG document only: no explanation and no Markdown code fence.
Draw this: a cat sitting down.

response.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="400" viewBox="0 0 400 400" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
  <title>A ginger cat sitting down</title>
  <desc>A round, three-dimensional tabby cat sits with its front paws together and its striped tail curled behind it.</desc>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="backdrop" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fbf4e9"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e9ddcf"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="halo" cx="42%" cy="35%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fffdf5" stop-opacity=".95"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#fff8e9" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="bodyFur" cx="28%" cy="18%" r="88%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffdaa0"/>
      <stop offset=".35" stop-color="#edaa65"/>
      <stop offset=".73" stop-color="#ce7d43"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#955234"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="headFur" cx="30%" cy="23%" r="82%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffe2ad"/>
      <stop offset=".4" stop-color="#f2b16d"/>
      <stop offset=".77" stop-color="#d88b4c"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#a85e39"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tailFur" x1="12%" y1="5%" x2="88%" y2="95%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e9a15b"/>
      <stop offset=".48" stop-color="#ca7841"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#8f4d32"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hindFur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="100%" y2="80%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#d98c4d"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#9b5535"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="leftLegFur" x1="0" y1="20%" x2="100%" y2="60%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f5b875"/>
      <stop offset=".5" stop-color="#e49a56"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#b9693c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="rightLegFur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="100%" y2="50%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e5a05e"/>
      <stop offset=".55" stop-color="#cb7c45"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#995335"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="earFur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f4b571"/>
      <stop offset=".58" stop-color="#d48649"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#9b5535"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="innerEar" x1="20%" y1="0" x2="70%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e9a297"/>
      <stop offset=".6" stop-color="#c77d75"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#995b58"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="creamFur" cx="35%" cy="25%" r="80%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff5dc"/>
      <stop offset=".65" stop-color="#eed4ad"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#cda77c"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="iris" cx="35%" cy="28%" r="75%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#eef3ad"/>
      <stop offset=".48" stop-color="#a8bf69"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#657d45"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="nose" x1="20%" y1="0" x2="75%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#f2b3a2"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#a85f5c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="groundBlur" x="-30%" y="-150%" width="160%" height="400%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="headLift" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#613b2c" flood-opacity=".2"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect width="400" height="400" fill="url(#backdrop)"/>
  <circle cx="194" cy="174" r="163" fill="url(#halo)"/>
  <path d="M54 351 C139 346 270 346 350 351" fill="none" stroke="#bda999" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".24"/>
  <ellipse cx="211" cy="351" rx="126" ry="17" fill="#725847" opacity=".25" filter="url(#groundBlur)"/>
  <ellipse cx="204" cy="349" rx="87" ry="8" fill="#694738" opacity=".18" filter="url(#groundBlur)"/>

  <!-- Curled tail, behind the seated body -->
  <g>
    <path d="M254 268 C287 267 319 282 329 305 C340 329 327 349 304 356 C282 362 251 351 235 337 C227 330 229 319 237 314 C245 309 252 313 259 321 C270 332 287 337 300 332 C311 328 313 319 306 311 C296 298 274 295 255 296 Z"
          fill="url(#tailFur)" stroke="#8f4d31" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M276 279 C300 283 318 295 323 309" fill="none" stroke="#ffd596" stroke-width="5" opacity=".28"/>
    <path d="M309 295 C318 301 324 308 327 316 L316 321 C314 313 309 307 301 303 Z" fill="#9f5734" opacity=".72"/>
    <path d="M330 325 C328 337 320 346 309 351 L301 339 C310 336 315 330 317 322 Z" fill="#965132" opacity=".75"/>
    <path d="M287 356 C274 354 262 350 252 343 L259 331 C268 337 278 340 288 341 Z" fill="#a55b36" opacity=".72"/>
    <path d="M239 315 C246 311 252 314 259 321 C263 325 267 328 272 331 C260 332 253 338 253 345 C246 342 240 339 235 335 C228 329 230 320 239 315 Z"
          fill="#edbd83" opacity=".8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Rear haunches and hind paws -->
  <g stroke="#925235" stroke-width="1.8">
    <path d="M151 247 C131 257 120 283 122 312 C123 329 131 341 145 345 C161 350 179 342 185 329 C191 310 183 272 174 254 Z"
          fill="url(#hindFur)"/>
    <path d="M250 249 C274 253 289 279 289 309 C289 330 279 343 261 345 C246 348 234 339 232 329 C227 303 232 269 250 249 Z"
          fill="url(#hindFur)"/>
    <path d="M137 319 C125 323 120 335 127 343 C136 353 164 351 175 344 C182 338 175 328 165 324 Z"
          fill="#cd8049"/>
    <path d="M250 322 C242 329 242 340 252 345 C264 351 283 346 287 337 C291 327 276 320 264 320 Z"
          fill="#b86b3e"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#875039" stroke-width="1.4" opacity=".65">
    <path d="M137 335 C136 340 137 344 139 347"/>
    <path d="M149 335 C149 340 150 344 152 347"/>
    <path d="M270 332 C272 336 272 341 271 344"/>
    <path d="M280 331 C282 334 282 338 281 341"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pear-shaped torso -->
  <path d="M198 170 C166 174 146 202 141 240 C135 279 142 315 158 334 C177 349 238 350 259 332 C274 313 276 271 267 232 C258 195 237 172 213 169 Z"
        fill="url(#bodyFur)" stroke="#955336" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M228 182 C253 207 262 244 258 284 C255 314 246 330 234 340 C251 338 261 328 266 307 C273 279 268 233 255 207 C247 193 238 185 228 182 Z"
        fill="#75432e" opacity=".16"/>
  <path d="M154 222 C146 248 146 282 153 305" fill="none" stroke="#ffdba3" stroke-width="4" opacity=".35"/>

  <!-- Body tabby markings -->
  <g fill="#a85d36" opacity=".62">
    <path d="M143 224 C151 221 160 223 166 229 C157 232 149 233 141 232 Z"/>
    <path d="M140 246 C149 243 157 246 162 252 C154 255 147 256 139 254 Z"/>
    <path d="M250 216 C257 220 262 226 264 233 C256 231 249 229 244 225 Z"/>
    <path d="M257 242 C263 246 267 252 269 259 C261 257 255 254 250 250 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Cream chest and soft shadow beneath the head -->
  <path d="M188 190 C177 208 172 233 175 258 C179 283 187 304 201 315 C215 303 224 282 226 255 C228 231 220 207 209 191 C204 197 194 197 188 190 Z"
        fill="url(#creamFur)" opacity=".96"/>
  <path d="M187 222 L197 233 L202 224 L210 233 L218 220" fill="none" stroke="#d0aa7c" stroke-width="1.6" opacity=".55"/>
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="198" rx="48" ry="17" fill="#82472f" opacity=".17"/>

  <!-- Straight forelegs and rounded front paws -->
  <g>
    <path d="M171 231 C165 259 164 295 165 325 C157 329 153 336 155 343 C158 352 184 354 195 347 C202 343 201 334 193 328 C196 295 198 261 192 233 C186 229 178 229 171 231 Z"
          fill="url(#leftLegFur)" stroke="#995737" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <path d="M211 232 C206 261 209 297 212 327 C204 332 203 340 208 346 C217 354 242 352 249 345 C255 338 247 330 239 326 C242 293 240 257 234 231 C227 228 218 228 211 232 Z"
          fill="url(#rightLegFur)" stroke="#8f5034" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <path d="M169 249 C166 275 167 303 169 321" fill="none" stroke="#ffdaa0" stroke-width="3" opacity=".43"/>
    <path d="M216 248 C213 275 216 302 218 320" fill="none" stroke="#f6bd7c" stroke-width="2.5" opacity=".28"/>
    <path d="M158 339 C167 334 187 334 196 340" fill="none" stroke="#f7bd7d" stroke-width="2" opacity=".42"/>
    <path d="M209 339 C218 334 238 333 247 339" fill="none" stroke="#e7a568" stroke-width="2" opacity=".35"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#915439" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".72">
    <path d="M167 337 C166 342 167 347 169 350"/>
    <path d="M180 337 C179 342 180 348 182 351"/>
    <path d="M219 337 C218 342 219 347 221 350"/>
    <path d="M233 336 C234 341 234 346 232 350"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Head, ears, and facial features -->
  <g filter="url(#headLift)">
    <path d="M130 119 L136 63 Q137 50 146 57 L183 85 Z"
          fill="url(#earFur)" stroke="#965337" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M220 83 L258 56 Q267 49 268 61 L272 120 Z"
          fill="url(#earFur)" stroke="#915036" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M141 103 L143 71 Q143 66 147 69 L171 87 Z"
          fill="url(#innerEar)" stroke="#aa6656" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <path d="M239 86 L258 70 Q261 67 261 72 L263 105 Z"
          fill="url(#innerEar)" stroke="#995c51" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <path d="M143 68 L145 91" fill="none" stroke="#ffd9ad" stroke-width="2.4" opacity=".55"/>
    <path d="M260 66 L261 92" fill="none" stroke="#f5bb86" stroke-width="2" opacity=".4"/>

    <path d="M197 75 C165 73 141 85 130 108 C122 124 123 141 125 151 L119 158 L128 162 C132 179 143 190 159 199 C182 211 219 210 243 197 C257 190 267 178 271 163 L280 158 L272 152 C276 131 271 111 262 96 C248 78 226 73 197 75 Z"
          fill="url(#headFur)" stroke="#955437" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M226 80 C254 89 269 108 271 137 C274 166 259 189 236 199 C218 207 197 208 181 204 C210 202 233 188 242 167 C253 141 248 105 226 80 Z"
          fill="#78452f" opacity=".13"/>
    <path d="M139 110 C132 126 132 143 135 151" fill="none" stroke="#ffe2b0" stroke-width="4" opacity=".42"/>

    <!-- Forehead and cheek stripes -->
    <g fill="#a96039" opacity=".72">
      <path d="M177 81 C181 91 187 99 192 104 L190 79 Z"/>
      <path d="M196 77 L200 102 L205 77 Z"/>
      <path d="M211 79 L209 103 C216 96 220 88 222 80 Z"/>
      <path d="M127 142 C137 138 145 140 152 145 L150 150 C141 147 134 147 126 149 Z"/>
      <path d="M130 158 C140 154 148 156 154 161 L154 166 C145 162 138 162 132 165 Z"/>
      <path d="M248 143 C256 139 264 140 272 144 L272 150 C264 147 257 147 249 150 Z"/>
      <path d="M247 160 C255 156 263 157 269 161 L266 166 C259 162 254 162 246 166 Z"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Muzzle and chin -->
    <ellipse cx="199" cy="184" rx="17" ry="10" fill="url(#creamFur)" opacity=".9"/>
    <ellipse cx="181" cy="170" rx="26" ry="20" fill="url(#creamFur)"/>
    <ellipse cx="217" cy="170" rx="26" ry="20" fill="url(#creamFur)"/>

    <!-- Almond-shaped eyes -->
    <path d="M146 135 C155 125 171 123 182 133 C174 146 157 149 147 140 Z"
          fill="url(#iris)" stroke="#593b2c" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <path d="M216 133 C227 123 243 125 252 136 C243 147 226 146 217 140 Z"
          fill="url(#iris)" stroke="#593b2c" stroke-width="2.4"/>
    <ellipse cx="165" cy="136" rx="3.7" ry="10.8" fill="#302d25"/>
    <ellipse cx="234" cy="135.5" rx="3.7" ry="10.8" fill="#302d25"/>
    <path d="M147 134 C157 124 171 124 181 132" fill="none" stroke="#70452e" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <path d="M217 132 C228 123 243 126 251 135" fill="none" stroke="#68422e" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <circle cx="160" cy="130" r="3.2" fill="#fffef0"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="130" r="3.2" fill="#fffef0"/>
    <circle cx="169" cy="141" r="1.3" fill="#eaf1c8" opacity=".85"/>
    <circle cx="238" cy="140" r="1.3" fill="#eaf1c8" opacity=".85"/>

    <!-- Nose, mouth, and whisker roots -->
    <path d="M190 156 C194 152 204 152 209 156 C208 161 204 165 200 166 C195 164 192 161 190 156 Z"
          fill="url(#nose)" stroke="#8f5550" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <ellipse cx="197" cy="155.5" rx="3" ry="1.4" fill="#ffd8c9" opacity=".8"/>
    <path d="M200 166 L200 172 M200 172 C195 179 188 178 185 174 M200 172 C205 179 212 178 215 174"
          fill="none" stroke="#765046" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <g fill="#9a735e" opacity=".7">
      <circle cx="169" cy="164" r="1.25"/>
      <circle cx="165" cy="170" r="1.15"/>
      <circle cx="171" cy="175" r="1.1"/>
      <circle cx="229" cy="164" r="1.25"/>
      <circle cx="233" cy="170" r="1.15"/>
      <circle cx="227" cy="175" r="1.1"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Whiskers -->
    <g fill="none" stroke="#72564a" stroke-width="1.35" opacity=".72">
      <path d="M164 165 C145 160 128 158 109 159"/>
      <path d="M163 172 C141 172 124 176 107 182"/>
      <path d="M166 179 C148 184 133 191 120 200"/>
      <path d="M235 165 C254 159 273 159 289 162"/>
      <path d="M236 172 C256 172 274 178 291 185"/>
      <path d="M233 179 C250 185 264 194 275 204"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
